prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity north-star composition for the JOBE desktop marketing homepage
Primary request: Design a real desktop website surface for JOBE, a founder-led senior engineering consultancy. This is composition A, “ROUTE SPINE,” within the approved SYSTEMS WAYFINDING visual world. Show the navigation, complete first viewport, and enough of the following services section to prove the page system. The deep-blue diagnostic route is the structural spine: it enters from the navigation legend, crosses the hero headline, passes through a concise founder-verdict plate, and branches into the three service outcomes below. The page must immediately communicate senior judgment, architecture evidence, and a Product Readiness Call.
Surface structure in order: compact route-legend header; asymmetric hero with oversized headline and real description; visible primary Product Readiness Call action and secondary StockCast action; large architecture topology fused into the hero rather than placed in a card; founder annotation plate; beginning of the three-service outcomes as branches from one diagnosis junction.
Style/medium: high-fidelity flat web UI design, precise contemporary infrastructure wayfinding, matte, editorial, production-believable
Composition/framing: 1536x1024 landscape desktop webpage, browserless, straight-on; hero occupies roughly 72% of image height, services transition visible below; oversized headline left-center, deep-blue systems field cuts vertically then horizontally through the fold, topology crosses layers without obscuring reading; purposeful asymmetry; no floating decoration
Color palette: deep engineering blue #173D8F carries 40% of the surface, near-white #F5F7FA, ink #111722, pale route blue #9FB5DF only; no second accent hue; no gradients
Typography: authoritative narrow grotesk inspired by infrastructure signage, not a system font, not monospace, high-impact large headline with disciplined small labels
Materials/components: enamel-signage blue fields, folded-map seams, hard-edged technical plates, clipped corners, hairline topology paths, route nodes, legends; almost no rounded rectangles; flat depth
Text (verbatim where legible): “JOBE”, “Engineering that Works”, “A senior engineering practice for AI products that need to work in production—and for the business.”, “Book a Product Readiness Call”, “Explore StockCast”, “AI Productization Sprint”, “Fractional CTO & Architecture”, “AI-Native SDLC & Engineering Enablement”. Do not invent any other claims, metrics, customers, credentials, prices, or logos. Minor explanatory text may be greeked.
Founder evidence: include a short plate labeled only “JOÃO BERTACCHI” with greeked annotation lines; do not invent a title, biography, or credential.
Responsive intent implied: topology must have an obvious vertical-spine adaptation for mobile.
Constraints: preserve current homepage section inventory and diagnostic-first story; architecture diagram is meaningful route geometry, not decorative circuitry; clear semantic-looking navigation and action controls; accessible contrast; no browser chrome
Avoid: generic SaaS split hero, wireframe cube, three equal floating cards, dashboard chrome, bento grid, gradients, glow, glassmorphism, neon hacker aesthetic, fake data, fake score values, stock illustration, 3D objects, excessive pills, excessive rounded cards, generic AI landing page, watermark
